mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the rate does not exceed 4.5% in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, which enhances corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and INDPRO does not significantly predict positive returns (p > 0.05 in OLS regression) or the correlation between their combined movement and returns falls below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% indicates labor market tightness, raising wage pressures and inflation expectations, which depresses equity valuations and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-tightness periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the rate does not exceed 6% in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 235 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to raise interest rates and reducing growth prospects, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the CPIAUCSL does not exceed 235 in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in labor employment (PAYEMS) above 142,000 suggests a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expanding labor markets are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the employment figure does not exceed 142,000 in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the INDPRO index above 106.2 signals robust supply-side growth, lowering production costs and increasing corporate margins, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply-side expansion periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the INDPRO does not exceed 106.2 in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand measured by both GDPC1 (total personal consumption expenditures) and HOUST (industrial output) indices signals robust economic activity, which enhances corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and HOUST does not significantly predict positive returns (p > 0.05 in OLS regression) or the correlation between their combined movement and returns falls below 0.3.
